lines.text: Hiram king of Tyre sends envoys to Solomon, who asks him to cut cedars of Lebanon for the LORD's house.
Hiram rejoices and promises that his servants will haul the logs to the Sea and float them as rafts.
Solomon sends Hiram 20,000 cors of wheat and 20,000 baths of olive oil each year, and the two make a treaty.
Solomon conscripts 30,000 men and sends them to Lebanon in monthly shifts of 10,000, with Adoniram in charge.
Solomon has 70,000 porters and 80,000 stonecutters, and he commands them to quarry large stones for the temple foundation.
